name: CPSAT
document: Layout from the SatNOGS decoder cpsat.ksy (CPSat BCN telemetry; the ksy cites https://github.com/SuperCuteRnRn/CPSAT_Telemetry_Sample/tree/main/decoder).
note: Imported from the SatNOGS decoder cpsat.ksy; not checked against frames FBSAT59 received (none yet). A CCSDS space packet inside an AX.25 UI frame; the byte at offset 16 (beacon_mode, 1-10) selects one of ten layouts of 94-232 bytes. Raw counts have a converted twin in engineering units (the ksy's *_converted values; temperatures use its polynomial/linear formulas). Fields the ksy publishes only when a sentinel value is absent (e.g. 0xFF or 0xFFFF) appear as *_present. The ksy's validity checks (CCSDS stream id, packet length versus size) are not applied. Offsets are counted from the AX.25 information field.
